svg.title: pyHyperRI logo (black text)
svg.desc: Horizontal pyHyperRI logo lockup. The 48 by 48 icon is vertically centered, and the package-name text is aligned to the same centerline.

g.title: pyHyperRI icon with rainbow ribbon
g.desc: Seven-strip rainbow ribbon built from the latest yellow route-study centerline. The antenna system is scaled as one unit by 1.08 and shifted along the background diagonal by 2.4 units. The ribbon starts from one fully opaque point, widens to 8.4 units, stays fully opaque to the previous endpoint at 36.8,40, then continues into an extended fading tail. Minimum centerline radius is 1.052; centerline clearance to visual ball is 11.023; full ribbon bounds are x 10.263 to 43.967 and y 5.153 to 47.638.

text.font-family: "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
